what: Role benchmarks on Codex models, effort low, through the factory harness. security: 6 planted vulnerabilities and 3 clean changes, one request each. builder: 6 small coding tickets judged by hidden tests, one attempt each. One run per model: a signal, not a guarantee.
security_note: hardcoded-secret was re-run with a realistic-looking key (the first key looked like a Stripe key and was blocked by GitHub push protection): gpt-6-luna, gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6.2-astra all caught it; a key literally named "not-a-real-key" was approved by luna and sol, a reasonable reading.
builder_note: All three passed all six: these small, well-specified tickets do not separate the models. The result supports starting small tickets on the cheaper model with the usual one as the step up; it does not show the cheaper model can do large or design-heavy tickets.
